errors.evidence: The x-axis tick labels are 16, 32, 64, 128, and 256. This is a non-linear (power of 2) scale, not a linear scale from 64 to 1632 with an interval of 64.
The y-axis tick marks are evenly spaced (9.5, 10.0, 10.5, etc.), indicating a linear scale, not a logarithmic scale.

The blue MoHD line generally increases from left to right, from a value of approximately 10.4 at x=16 to a peak of approximately 10.65 at x=128, before a slight drop to 10.6 at x=256. It does not decrease overall.
The blue MoHD line starts at an x-value of 16 (the first tick mark), not 64. The corresponding y-value is approximately 10.4, not 10.6.
The blue MoHD line ends at an x-value of 256, not 1632. The corresponding y-value is approximately 10.6, not 10.3.
The red Transformer line spans the entire x-axis, beginning at x=16, not x=64. The value is also slightly above 11.5, closer to 11.6.
The description of the MoHD line as a 'blue solid line' omits the square markers present at each data point.
